name: Bangkok Chain Hospital Public Company Limited
summary: Bangkok Chain Hospital Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates private hospitals in Bangkok vicinity, Chiang Rai, Saraburi, Nonthaburi, Pathumthani, Ayudhaya, Chachoengsao, Prachinburi, Sa Kaeo Province, and Lao People's Democratic Republic. It offers diagnosis, treatment, prevention, rehabilitation services for heart disease; open heart surgery to provide heart care and clinical treatment by cardiologists; and medical supports.
